citations.claim: initially stationary 1kg body gained vx=100 in a single step after being hit by 0.2kg body at 60 m/s
total energy exploded from ~431J to ~5231J in one step with no controller work

explanation: Two circles start 3.0 apart (radii 1.2+0.5=1.7) with body1 at -60 m/s. In one dt=1/30 step body1 travels ~2m causing deep overlap. The impulse/substep solver produces vx=100 for the 1kg stationary body and vx=-40 for the 0.2kg body: momentum goes from -12 to +92 and energy from 431J to 5231J. Likely the collision impulse uses wrong effective mass / applies positional-correction velocity or repeated impulses across 68 substeps without conserving momentum, injecting energy on high-speed deep-penetration contacts.
vision_note: The small blue circle starts separated to the right of the large blue circle and in one step closes the gap to press into contact with it. The pair ends in touching deep contact with no rebound separation visible, consistent with a single-step deep penetration.
